title: Investor & partnerships policy (feed the evolution)
body: khalid's team and friends want to invest in the evolution, utilization, and partnerships. This card authorizes the fleet to: (1) prepare the public transparency feed (fleet.bawes.net public mode) as the investor storefront, (2) define the investment instrument (banana-denominated contribution + BYOK reward mechanics, per rate-card v0.1.0), (3) run utilization reporting so investors see real capacity use, (4) open partnerships intake. Sequenced AFTER transparency+strategic layers show real activity (empty-market credibility rule).
